<function name="GetHistoryEnabled" parent="DTextEntry" type="panelfunc">
	<description>Returns whether the history functionality of  <page>DTextEntry</page> is enabled. See <page>DTextEntry:AddHistory</page>.
</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">Whether the history is enabled or not.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
